info.title: TUMIIA API
info.description: Intelligent filing for construction project documents.

post.summary: Creates an account and signs the new user in.
post.description: Returns an access token in the body and sets the refresh token cookie. No email confirmation yet.

post.summary: Signs in with an email and password.
post.description:
Returns an access token in the body and sets the refresh token cookie. A wrong email, a wrong password and
a locked account all get the same 401. Five wrong passwords lock the account for 15 minutes.

post.summary: Swaps the refresh token cookie for a new access token (and a new refresh token).
post.description:
Call this when the app loads, and after a 401, to stay signed in. If an old refresh token is used again, the
whole sign-in is ended for safety.

post.summary: Signs out: revokes the refresh token and clears its cookie.

post.description: Always answers 202, whether or not the email has an account, so it cannot be used to find accounts.

post.summary: Sets a new password using the email and token from a reset link.
post.description: On success the user is signed out everywhere and must sign in with the new password.

post.summary: Step 2 of uploading: tell the API the file has been PUT to its upload address.
post.description:
The API checks the file is in storage and is the announced size, marks the document New and queues it for
analysis. 409 when the file has not arrived or is the wrong size. Safe to call again.

get.summary: Gets one document with everything known about it.
get.description:
Once analysed, `analysis` holds the AI's proposal: the category, a one-line summary, and each field with its
own confidence and where in the file it was found. While the status is New or Processing, `analysis` is
null; poll every few seconds.

get.summary: Gets a 5-minute address to view or download the original file.
get.description: PDFs and common images open in the browser; other files download under their original name. 409 when the file has not been uploaded yet.

get.summary: Checks that the API is running and can reach the database.
get.description:
Anonymous, so the load balancer can call it. Returns 200 when every check passes and 503 when any fails.
Only the name and result of each check are returned, never error details.

post.summary: Creates a project vault. The caller becomes its owner.

get.summary: Lists the caller's projects, newest first.

get.description: 404 when it does not exist or the caller is not a member (the two are not told apart).

post.summary: Step 1 of uploading: get an upload address for each file.
post.description:
Send up to 50 files' names, types, sizes and SHA-256 hashes. Each new file gets a document id and a 5-minute
pre-signed address to PUT the file to, with exactly that Content-Type and size. A file already in the project
gets `existingDocumentId` instead. Files with a type TUMIIA does not take, or over 50 MB, are refused
with 400, and then nothing is created.

post.summary: Adds pasted text or a copied message to the project.
post.description:
The text is stored unchanged as a .txt file (named after `title`, if given) and queued for analysis, like an
uploaded file. 201 with the new document; 200 with the existing document when exactly this text is already in
the project.

get.summary: Lists a project's documents, newest first.
get.description: Filter by `status` (for example NeedsReview) and by `category` (the confirmed document type). Unfinished uploads are left out unless you ask for status PendingUpload.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Only documents with this confirmed document type.

pipelineVersion.description: The version of the analysis steps.

detectedLanguage.description: ISO 639-1 language code, or "und" when it could not be told.

proposedCategory.description: The proposed category key, such as commercial_quote.

proposedCategoryName.description: The proposed category's display name, such as "Quote".

runnerUpCategory.description: The second most likely category key, if any.

classificationConfidence.description: How sure the AI is about the category, from 0 to 1. Show it as words.

band.description: The confidence as High, Medium or Low, using the category's thresholds.

outcome.description: What the analysis decided: AutoFiled, AwaitingConfirmation or NeedsReview.

summary.description: One plain line, such as "Quote from ABC Supplies for Bricks — R18,450.00, 12 Oct 2026."

fields.description: The facts found, each with its own confidence and evidence. The first is always document_type.

signals.description: The signals behind the classification confidence.

warnings.description: Reading problems and confidence limits, in plain words.

AnalysisResponse.description: What the AI proposed for a document. It is never changed; a person's confirmation is stored separately.

accessToken.description: The JWT to send with each API call. Valid for 15 minutes.

expiresAt.description: When the access token stops working (UTC).

AuthResponse.description:
A signed-in session. The access token goes in the `Authorization: Bearer` header and should be kept in
memory only. The refresh token is not in the body: it is set as an HttpOnly cookie.

name.description: The project's name, for example "Mokoena Residence".

displayName.description: The name shown in the app.

contentTypeDetected.description: The real file type, once analysed.

extensionMatches.description: Whether the real type matches the extension, once analysed.

correctionFlag.description: True once a person changed something the AI proposed.

confirmedFields.description: The confirmed fields, as JSON, once confirmed.

failureReason.description: Why the analysis gave up, when the status is Failed.

analysis.description: The latest analysis, or null while the document is New or Processing.

DocumentDetailResponse.description:
Everything about one document, including the AI's latest analysis (proposed category, fields and their
confidence) once it has run.

contentTypeClaimed.description: The file type the browser reported.

captureSource.description: How the file arrived: drag_drop, file_picker, mobile_upload or paste.

status.description: Where the document is: New, Processing, AutoFiled, AwaitingConfirmation, NeedsReview, Confirmed or Failed.

consequenceLevel.description: How much a wrong filing would matter, once analysed.

needsReview.description: True when a person must look at it.

documentTypeConfirmed.description: The category a person confirmed, if any.

subjectConfirmed.description: The subject a person confirmed, if any.

DocumentResponse.description: A document, as shown in lists.

name.description: The field, such as document_type, party, amount, currency, document_date, subject.

value.description: The value: dates as yyyy-MM-dd, amounts as plain numbers ("18450.00"), currencies as ISO codes ("ZAR").

confidence.description: From 0 to 1, for this field alone. Show it as words, not as a number.

band.description: The confidence as High, Medium or Low (High at 0.75 or more, Medium at 0.50 or more).

method.description: How it was found: hosted (the AI on Bedrock), regex, keyword or exif.

ExtractedFieldResponse.description: One fact the AI found. These are suggestions until a person confirms them.

source.description: What it was read from: bedrock (the AI read it), text, exif or classification.

page.description: The page (or sheet) number, when it came from the text.

line.description: The line number on that page.

snippet.description: A short quote of the words it came from. Ends "(not found in the document's text)" when the AI's quote could not be checked against the typed text.

FieldEvidenceResponse.description: Where a fact was found in the original file.

ForgotPasswordRequest.description: The email to send a reset link to.

HealthCheckEntry.description: The result of one health check, such as the database connection.

status.description: "Healthy" when every check passed, otherwise "Unhealthy" or "Degraded".

checks.description: The result of each individual check.

HealthResponse.description: The result of the health check.

text.description: The text, exactly as pasted. Stored unchanged as a .txt file.

title.description: An optional title, used as the file name ("Site instruction" becomes "Site instruction.txt").

PasteTextRequest.description: Text or a message the user pasted in.

role.description: The caller's role in the project.

email.description: The email to sign in with.

password.description: At least 10 characters, with an upper-case letter, a lower-case letter, a digit and a symbol.

displayName.description: The name shown in the app.

newPassword.description: The new password. Same rules as on registration.

ResetPasswordRequest.description: A new password, with the email and token from the reset link.

url.description: Open or download the file here. PDFs and images open in the browser; other files download.

expiresAt.description: When the address stops working (UTC). Ask again after that.

SourceUrlResponse.description: A short-lived address for the original file.

fileName.description: The file's name, with its extension.

contentType.description: The file's type as the browser reports it (for example `application/pdf`). Must be sent again, exactly, on the upload.

sizeBytes.description: The file's size in bytes. The upload must be exactly this size.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the file's bytes, as 64 hexadecimal characters (Web Crypto `crypto.subtle.digest`).

UploadFileRequest.description: One file the browser wants to upload.

captureSource.description: How the files were picked: `drag_drop`, `file_picker` or `mobile_upload`.

files.description: The files. At most 50 per request (configurable).

UploadRequestsRequest.description: The files the browser wants to upload in one go, and how they were picked.

UploadRequestsResponse.description: One answer per requested file, in the order sent.

fileName.description: The file name as sent, to match answers to files.

documentId.description: The new document's id, when the file should be uploaded.

uploadUrl.description: Where to PUT the file, with the same Content-Type and exact size. Works for 5 minutes.

existingDocumentId.description: The document that already has this file, when it is a duplicate.

UploadTargetResponse.description:
What to do with one file: PUT it to `UploadUrl` (then call `/documents/{documentId}/uploaded`),
or nothing, because `ExistingDocumentId` already holds the same file.

Bearer.description: Paste the access token returned by the login endpoint.
